title: Scaling of Replenishment Debits after Returned Deposits — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
**Clause.** A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service with a returned deposit dated fewer than 3 whole months before today has a returned-deposit multiplier of 0.5 on its replenishment debit, one whose latest returned deposit is older than that but dated fewer than twelve whole months before today has a multiplier of 0.75, and any other service has a multiplier of one, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's.

A returned deposit is a deposit return on the service's ledger: a prefund deposit the employer's bank returned unpaid; its date is the entry date of that deposit return.

| Latest deposit return on the ledger | Returned-deposit multiplier |
|---|---|
| fewer than 3 whole months before today | 0.5 |
| 3 or more but fewer than 12 whole months before today | 0.75 |
| 12 or more whole months before today, or none | one |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, today the 9th of a month)

- A deposit return dated the 10th, three calendar months earlier: 2 whole months, 0.5.
- Dated the 9th, three calendar months earlier: 3 whole months, 0.75.
- Dated the 10th, twelve calendar months earlier: 11 whole months, 0.75.
- Dated the 9th, twelve calendar months earlier: 12 whole months, one.
